lines: Today’s fast-paced lifestyle makes us put one thing on top of another.
Many people believe that multitasking saves time, but it doesn’t.
Very often, multitasking only slows you down.
Give your whole focus to what you’re doing at the moment.
While doing the laundry, just do the laundry.
Listen to the sound of the water as it fills the washing machine and feel the clothes in your hand.
Talking on the phone while you are doing the laundry will not save you a lot of time.
The same applies to all your work.
Focus on one task at a time, and you’ll accomplish each task better, and probably faster.
